_comment: Settings every project shares. A project's project.json only needs projectId (plus title); anything it sets wins over this file, key by key. {key} is replaced with the project's folder name. Used at build time only, never embedded in a page.

source._comment: One call per refresh: baseUrl?accessToken=<VL_TOKEN_<CODE> secret>&projectId=<projectId>&type=<type>&<extraQuery>. sampleFile is what --source sample reads (.json or .json.gz).
